# TanStack Start + shadcn/ui Starter

> A full-stack React template combining TanStack Start for SSR and routing, shadcn/ui for components, Drizzle ORM for type-safe database access, and Tailwind CSS v4 for styling.

This is a complete full-stack starter template that provides everything needed to build modern React applications with server-side rendering, database persistence, and a polished UI. The stack is designed for developer experience with TypeScript end-to-end, file-based conventions, and minimal configuration.

## Technology Stack

**Frontend & Routing**
- React 19 with server components support
- TanStack Router for type-safe file-based routing with search params and loaders
- TanStack Start for SSR, server functions, and React Server Components

**UI & Styling**
- shadcn/ui components built on Base UI (accessible, unstyled primitives)
- Tailwind CSS v4 with CSS variables for theming
- Lucide React for iconography
- Class Variance Authority for component variant management

**Backend & Server**
- Nitro server for production deployment (supports Node.js, Bun, Deno, and serverless)
- Server functions for type-safe client-server communication
- Hono-based API routes for REST endpoints

**Database**
- Drizzle ORM for type-safe SQL queries with SQLite
- Drizzle Kit for schema management and migrations
- Better-SQLite3 for local development database

**Build & Tooling**
- Vite for development server and bundling
- TypeScript with strict mode and path aliases
- Vitest for testing with jsdom environment
- ESLint and Prettier for code quality

## Documentation

- [README](README.md): Project overview and getting started guide
- [TanStack Start Docs](https://tanstack.com/start): Official TanStack Start documentation
- [shadcn/ui Docs](https://ui.shadcn.com): shadcn/ui component documentation

## Configuration

- [package.json](package.json): Project dependencies and npm scripts
- [tsconfig.json](tsconfig.json): TypeScript configuration with path aliases (@/* maps to ./src/*)
- [vite.config.ts](vite.config.ts): Vite, TanStack Start, Tailwind CSS, and Nitro plugin configuration
- [components.json](components.json): shadcn/ui configuration for component generation
- [drizzle.config.ts](drizzle.config.ts): Drizzle ORM schema and database configuration

## Source Structure

- [src/router.tsx](src/router.tsx): TanStack Router configuration and setup
- [src/routeTree.gen.ts](src/routeTree.gen.ts): Auto-generated route tree from file-based routing
- [src/styles.css](src/styles.css): Global styles and Tailwind CSS imports
- [src/lib/utils.ts](src/lib/utils.ts): Utility functions including cn() for class merging

## Routes

- [src/routes/__root.tsx](src/routes/__root.tsx): Root route layout component
- [src/routes/index.tsx](src/routes/index.tsx): Home page route with example todo app
- [src/routes/health.ts](src/routes/health.ts): Health check API endpoint

## Components

- [src/components/ui/button.tsx](src/components/ui/button.tsx): Button component with variants
- [src/components/ui/card.tsx](src/components/ui/card.tsx): Card component for content containers
- [src/components/ui/checkbox.tsx](src/components/ui/checkbox.tsx): Checkbox form component
- [src/components/ui/input.tsx](src/components/ui/input.tsx): Input form component

## Database & Drizzle ORM

- [src/db/index.ts](src/db/index.ts): Database connection initialization and exports
- [src/db/schema.ts](src/db/schema.ts): Drizzle ORM table definitions with TypeScript types
- [drizzle/](drizzle/): SQL migrations generated by Drizzle Kit
- [drizzle.config.ts](drizzle.config.ts): Drizzle Kit configuration (dialect: SQLite, dev database: ./data/dev.db)

Drizzle ORM provides type-safe database access with SQL-like syntax. Run `npx drizzle-kit generate` to create migrations and `npx drizzle-kit migrate` to apply them.

## API

- [src/api/todos/index.ts](src/api/todos/index.ts): Server function for todo operations

## Testing

- [vitest run](https://vitest.dev): Test command using Vitest framework

## Optional

- [public/manifest.json](public/manifest.json): Web app manifest for PWA support
- [src/logo.svg](src/logo.svg): Project logo asset
